paragraphs: Hi, I’m **Jay (Xinkai) Zou**. I study AI for simulation and efficient AI.

I'm building ai for social simulation from verification ([SSA](https://social-simulation-arena.com/)), methodology ([Group Behavior](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.09874)), environment (ongoing). I also study efficient ai from post-training ([Expert-Condenser](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.23036)) and pruning ([less-is-moe](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2606.05538)).
I’m an MS student in Computer Science at UC San Diego, advised by Jingbo Shang. Previously, I did my B.Eng in Software Engineering at Tongji University and exchange at UC Berkeley.
I'm open to collaboration and chat.
